design.finite_reference: This/that/the plus the same Object/Subject/Item type, with one explicit adjacent finite declaration. General claim references need an adjacent complete quotation, reply with full supplement, or complete same-sentence apposition. No arbitrary redefinition graph/numeric AST.
design.property_scope: Clear physical component width/height/diameter/thickness/colour/material and printed font/colour/document page count. A launch component modifier is not itself a product event. No arbitrary vocabulary/syntax understanding required.
